name: badge
description: A small label for status, count, or category — inline with text or attached to another element. Semantic variants (info/success/warning/destructive/invert) in solid, light and outline styles; neutral `muted`/`muted-outline` for inactive or pending states; and a `*-dot` family (primary/success/warning/info/destructive/muted) that shows a colored dot before plain text, for select items and dense lists. Plus size and radius options. Can also render as a link.
